items.title: A filtered colimit of smooth algebras with Noetherian fibres is a regular ring map
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of smooth algebras over a ring is regular as a ring map provided its fibres are Noetherian. The proof verifies the two defining properties of regularity: flatness of the colimit follows from flatness of smooth algebras together with stability of flatness under filtered colimits, and for the fibres the author extends the residue field by a finite purely inseparable extension, rewrites the base changed fibre as a filtered colimit of smooth algebras over that field, and concludes that its local rings are regular because local rings of smooth algebras over a field are regular and regularity is preserved by filtered colimits.
